notes: Seven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The paired coat-closet and laundry-closet leaves are reported separately because each leaf is manipulated independently. Left/right identification for the laundry leaves is somewhat uncertain due to camera rotation, but the two distinct opening and closing actions are visually supported.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes two coat-closet leaves, two laundry-closet leaves, a refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
